lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five horizontal rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible; spatial density is highest near the branchial region and decreases towards the caudal peduncle as centroid distance increases.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like coordinate system most visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal feature is visible on the upper mid-flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to low-luminance ventral shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear feature of high pixel intensity, consistent with a dermal abrasion or scar, is visible on the mid-flank posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, low-diameter luminance clusters (micro-spots) is visible on the cephalic region and the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
